LanguageData.LP_AK_Lair.label: clear the monster nest
LanguageData.LP_AK_Lair.description: Monsters have nested in the wilds, threatening passing caravans. Wipe out every monster at the site (killed or downed) to complete it.
LanguageData.LP_AK_Bounty.label: hunt the outlaw
LanguageData.LP_AK_Bounty.description: A hostile leader with a class is hiding in the wilds with guards. Kill or capture the leader to complete it; capturing (locked in a colony prison cell) pays ×1.25.
LanguageData.LP_AK_Rescue.label: rescue the trapped adventurer
LanguageData.LP_AK_Rescue.description: An adventurer has fallen in the wilds, surrounded by monsters. Bring them back to the colony alive (onto the colony map) to complete it; afterwards you can recruit them or claim a bounty.
LanguageData.LP_AK_Recover.label: recover the lost item
LanguageData.LP_AK_Recover.description: The client's heirloom has fallen into a gang's hands. Bring it back to the colony to complete it.
LanguageData.LP_AK_Haunted.label: investigate the haunted ruins
LanguageData.LP_AK_Haunted.description: The dead in the ruins have risen. Destroy the undead source to complete it.
LanguageData.LP_AK_Legend.label: slay the legendary monster
LanguageData.LP_AK_Legend.description: A legendary monster has appeared. Destroy (or drive off) every enemy at the site to complete it. Appears only occasionally once your renown reaches "Legendary".
